summary: Cheniere Energy Partners, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a lump-sum turnkey EPC contract with Bechtel Energy, Inc. for the engineering, procurement, and construction of the Sabine Pass LNG Stage V liquefaction project (Train 7 and a boil-off gas re-liquefaction unit) in Cameron Parish, Louisiana. The contract price is approximately $4.69 billion, subject to adjustment via change orders for delays, force majeure, or other specified events. The filing includes provisions for performance and delay liquidated damages. This is a routine construction services agreement, not a special-situation corporate transaction. No securities, ownership changes, or M&A activity are involved. The registrant is the customer/filer engaging a contractor for project development.
